newsitem.title: BERMUDA: Sphere to transfer P&I business to Winterthur.
newsitem.headline: Sphere to transfer P&I business to Winterthur.

text.p: Sphere Drake Holdings Ltd said it has reached an agreement in principle to transfer its Protection & Indemnity (P&I) business to the HIH Winterthur Insurance Group, the Australian-based subsidiary of Winterthur Insurance Co.

HIH Casualty & General Insurance Ltd will acquire the full P&I underwriting and claims team and all the business relationships and, effective immediately, will be offfering quotations for renewal and new business, Sphere Drake said.
HIH Casualty & General also will manage the run-off of Sphere Drake's P&I business, although the financial responsibility for the run-off will remain with Sphere Drake.

Sphere Drake, which said it will not receive any major consideration in return for the transfer, said the transaction forms part of its recently announced plan to focus only on lines of business where it can offer meaningful capacity and support to its customers.

"From Sphere Drake's point of view, this transaction marks another significant step towards achieving our goal of being a highly focused provider of traditional and alternative reinsurance protection and specialty insurance lines of business, Sphere Drake chief executive Michael Watson said.
Sphere Drake, through its companies in London and Bermuda, said it provides traditional and alternative reinsurance and specialty insurance protection, with an emphasis on U.S.-based clients.
